reviews.title: Talk about productivity
reviews.comment: Talk about productivity, this monitor delivers. Great display quality, fast and responsive. Love that it connects using USB-C, which makes it compatible and easier to hook up with my laptop.
reviews.author: LucianoR

reviews.title: Why would this defective item be sold to anyone?
reviews.comment: The item was defective and it appeared it had been previously put together, taken apart then resold. The photo shows screw holes that are supposed to hold the desk together but the screws just fall out of these holes which are disintegrating and are filled with dust. Additionally, one of the brackets is not flush and doesn't align with the keyboard platform. Overall a terrible product!
reviews.author: NancyC

reviews.title: Amazing Monitor for Work and Daily Use
reviews.comment: am extremely happy with this LG 34” UltraWide curved monitor. The screen quality is excellent, the colors are vibrant, and the extra wide space makes multitasking so easy. I can keep multiple windows open side-by-side with no problem. The curved design feels very natural and comfortable to use for long hours, and the 100Hz refresh rate keeps everything smooth. Setup was simple, and the build quality feels solid. Overall, this monitor has been a great upgrade for my home office and I highly recommend it!
reviews.author: EmmaG

reviews.title: LG-UltraWide 34" - Perfect Dual Computer Monitor
reviews.comment:
I absolutely love the LG UltraWide 34" Curved Monitor! I’d been looking for a monitor that could display two different computers at the same time, and after three failed attempts with other computers that claimed to do it, this one actually does — and it does it perfectly.
Setup was simple, and it’s incredibly easy to switch between viewing both computers side-by-side or using the entire screen for one. The image quality is excellent, and the functionality is flawless. This monitor is exactly what I needed. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: DCollins

reviews.title: LG 34 wide monitor
reviews.comment: Beautiful colors. Very easy to navigate. Down load the manual for reference. Fast delivery arrived earlier than expected.
reviews.author: StevenS
